title: Lavencia Oranges
statement: An array of length n (n up to 2·10^5, values in 1..n) must minimize max over i of i·c_i, where c_i counts values occurring exactly i times. At cost K, frequency i fits at most floor(K/i) values, so capacity is Σ i·floor(K/i) and every total up to it is reachable; the answer is the smallest K reaching n (at most 494), built greedily from the largest frequency down.
